title: 犬と肉 (Inu to Niku / The Dog and the Meat)
description: A dog carrying a piece of meat crosses a bridge and sees his reflection in the water. Thinking it is another dog with a bigger piece of meat, he snaps at the reflection — and drops his own meat into the river. A lesson about greed. One of Aesop's most structurally simple fables.
author: Aesop (adapted by NPO多言語多読)
